name: v2-any-cast
source: Phase 77 live adversary test: the seeded e2e type error 'fixed' with `as any` passed every deterministic rule
patch:
diff --git a/src/price.ts b/src/price.ts
--- a/src/price.ts
+++ b/src/price.ts
@@ -2,2 +2,2 @@
-  const sum: string = prices.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
-  return sum
+  const sum: string = prices.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) as any
+  return sum as any
